title: CloudHelm
summary: A multi-cloud service brokerage and contract automation platform. Customers order and manage infrastructure through one portal; Node.js middleware orchestrates Python/Flask services that provision across AWS, Azure, GCP and VMware, automate contracts, and hand off to NOC managed operations. Every change lands on an event bus that drives the Airflow billing ETL, the MRR billing engine and the NetSuite ERP sync.
